{{Short description|Dutch mathematician}}
'''Jacobus Franciscus (Jacques) Benders''' (1 June 1924 – 9 January  2017) was a Dutch [[mathematician]] and emeritus Professor of [[Operations Research]] at the [[Eindhoven University of Technology]]. He was the first Professor in the Netherlands in the field of Operations Research<ref name="GA94">Gerard Alberts en Jan Schut (1994). ''Wiskunde en praktijk in historische perspectief: reader''. p.170.</ref> and is known for his contributions to [[mathematical programming]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Jacques F. (Jac) Benders|url=http://www.online-familieberichten.nl/pers/1465580/Jacques-F-Jac-Benders-1924-2017|publisher=Online Familieberichten|accessdate=11 April 2017}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Benders studied mathematics at the [[Utrecht University]], where he later also received his PhD in 1960 with the thesis entitled "Partitioning in Mathematical Programming" under supervision of [[Hans Freudenthal]].<ref name="MGP">{{MathGenealogy|name=Jacques F. Benders}}</ref>

Late 1940s had started his career as statistician for the Rubber Foundation. In 1955, he moved to Shell laboratory in Amsterdam, where he researched [[mathematical programming]] problems concerning the logistics of [[oil refinery]]. He developed the technique known as [[Benders' decomposition]], and used the results in his doctoral thesis.

In 1963, Benders was appointed Professor of [[Operations Research]] at the [[Eindhoven University of Technology]], being the first Professor in the Netherlands in that field. Among his PhD students were Israel Herschberg (1966), [[Jaap Wessels]] (1968), Freerk Lootsma (1970), Joseph Evers (1973), Jan van Geldrop (1980), Robert van der Vet (1980) Johannes van der Wal (1980), and Jacob Koene (1982). He retired at the Eindhoven University of Technology on May 31, 1989.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.win.tue.nl/lotgevallen/em/ |title=Oud-medewerkers van de faculteit Wiskunde en Informatica van de Technische Universiteit Eindhoven (en haar voorgangers) 1 januari 1963–31 mei 1989 |access-date=2013-09-21 |archive-date=2013-09-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130925080602/http://www.win.tue.nl/lotgevallen/em/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2009 he was awarded the [[EURO Gold Medal]], the highest distinction within [[Operations Research]] in Europe.

== Publications ==
Benders has authored and co-authored dozens publications.<ref>[http://oametuep.uci.ru.nl/metue/pk_apa_n.medewerker?p_url_id=3778 Benders, J. F.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130926170746/http://oametuep.uci.ru.nl/metue/pk_apa_n.medewerker?p_url_id=3778 |date=2013-09-26 }} list of publications 1980–85.</ref> Books, a selection:
* 1960. ''Partitioning in mathematical programming''. Doctoral thesis Utrecht University.
* 1961. ''Mathematische programmering: syllabus college Rijksuniversiteit Utrecht 1960–1961''
* 1964. ''[http://alexandria.tue.nl/extra2/redes/benders1964.pdf De taak van de wiskunde in de operations research]''. Inaugurele rede.
* 1982. ''Een decision support systeem voor locatie en allocatieproblemen bij een drankenconcern''. With [[Jo van Nunen]].

Articles, a selection:
* Benders, Jacques F. "[https://web.archive.org/web/20130925071622/http://www.mat.puc-rio.br/~hjbortol/disciplinas/2006.1/soe/arquivos/benders-numerische-mathematik-1962.pdf Partitioning procedures for solving mixed-variables programming problems]." Numerische mathematik 4.1 (1962): 238–252.
